description: This file contains unit tests for agent-related asynchronous functions, including testing message retrieval, agent run waiting logic, and drain detection. It uses mocks to simulate external dependencies and verifies correct handling of responses and timeouts.

methods.name: readLatestAssistantReply
methods.description: Fetches and returns the latest assistant message content, ignoring system and toolResult messages, including handling message compaction markers.

methods.name: readLatestAssistantReplySnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves a snapshot of the latest assistant reply, including a fingerprint for delta comparison.

methods.name: waitForAgentRun
methods.description: Waits for a specific agent run to complete within a timeout, returning status and timing info.

methods.name: waitForAgentRunAndReadUpdatedAssistantReply
methods.description: Waits for an agent run to produce new assistant output differing from a baseline.

methods.name: waitForAgentRunsToDrain
methods.description: Polls and waits until all descendant agent runs have finished, with timeout handling and deduplication of run IDs.
